lines: Me
Phew, sheesh... What a terrifying experience.
I had managed to shake off the girls, but had also completely lost Saika's trail.
Me
Alright, let's see... I'd really like to find her before it gets dark.
Shikanosuke
Humhuhuum~♪
While I was contemplating that, Shikanosuke came from across the way.
Me
Hey, Shikanosuke, you seem to be in a terribly good mood, humming like that.
Shikanosuke
Hehe, you won't believe this, Fuma! My cousin stopped by the house and she gave me some chocolate!
A not-so-small box was gleaming in his hand.
Me
Wh-What!? Your cousin... do you mean the super strict Uehara Rin-sensei!?
Shikanosuke's older cousin was a skilled Electric Art user known far and wide as the "Dazzling Bolt Taimanin."
I knew her well, too, because when she wasn't on a mission, she sometimes taught at the academy as a non-staff teacher.
Shikanosuke
Despite how she appears, nee-chan actually likes sweets quite a bit.
Shikanosuke
And these are really good ones! Shall I bestow one upon you, Fuma? Hm?
Me
Th-That won't be necessary!!!
Shikanosuke
Alright, then I'll eat it all by myself♪ Later!
Me
Damn it...
Me
(Chocolate from the sexy Uehara Rin-sensei... I'm so jealous of that jerk! Traitor!)
I watched Shikanosuke skip down the street, cursing him in my mind.
Me
I can't believe even Shikanosuke beat me to it... I'll have to do whatever it takes to secure Saika's chocolate!
